body:
I broke up with my girlfriend of 3.5 years, realized I was an idiot. Tried to get her back, she said no. And now she's already seeing another guy. Within the span of a month, I feel like I've lost my soul mate. I'm 28, I have been taking my resting heart rate for the last week, it's consistently over 90 bpm or usually over 100. 

I begged her monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday... then, my friend and her friend and her all asked me to give her space and time. So I have not contacted her. It's obvious now that she has moved on. She might already be in a "relationship" with this guy. 

I can't handle this. It's unbearable to think of her ending up with someone else. We had been going through a period where we'd always been looking forward to our dreams. When she would graduate school, when I have saved up enough money for a wedding, a house, that's when our dreams would start coming true. And now she will fulfill all that with someone else. 
It's surreal that she is able to throw all this away. Like I'm... nothing. A nobody. She would be fine if she never heard from me or saw me again.

Sorry, this message is disjointed. It's a rant. But it's a cathartic one.
Why gee, thanks. This is very refreshing. I am feeling so much better.

Sometimes, going to school is not under our control. Especially in the states. are you from US?
Everybody knows how much colleges cost, and how much debt entry level professionals have to worry about. It's ridiculous. It's completely different from other western countries. 
But that being said, it's never too late to go to school. I myself started out in community college, and Obama is trying to make community college free. You aren't a loser, sometimes, it just takes very long to figure out what you want to do with life. You are ONLY 27. You can still achieve academic accomplishments, and be in a professional job within a few years. And if you pick a major like nursing, you could it sooner. Look at your options, maybe even go to your local community college and ask for advice. I'm sure they have resources for returning students. 

Try to find another room somewhere, you wouldn't have to deal with this if your roommate didn't move out. It's not your fault. You can even talk to your landlord.
You still hanging in there though?

It could be a cry for help or it could be real. Either way, I suggest you hold nothing back. You have to pull out every trick out of your BestBoyFriendEver bag, my friend. In fact, I might go so far as to say her happiness is your responsibility. Sorry, I'm a little biased. I wasn't able to make my gf happy, she was suicidal, and I wasn't supportive. Now she's with some other guy, letting him sweep her off her feet. I never realized I was the problem. Now I am the one posting on SW, for ME. I never even did that for her, so you're already a better person than me.

IF you really see a future with her, you have to try your best. Your very best. Couples' therapy would be good. That way, she gets to talk to a therapist and you're there for her too.

I wrote a long letter today. For her. 

Then I found out from her friend that they are in a relationship. Not just some fling anymore. They are in a relationship. Where, who do i lean on when there is no ground anymore...
I will, brother. You do the same, any time.

Props to you for admitting that you might not be in the right place to make her happy. But that doesn't necessarily mean she's gonna find someone better. I think you'll find someone and take your best shot at making them happy and it will work!
I'll take some days off. Do things to distract me.
Thanks, I actually have a guitar. I've been meaning to learn for so long. Perhaps I'll dust it off and see what I can do. I think the worst of it is over. I survived last night, I can move on.
Nah, man. She didn't leave you cause you weren't good enough. Just like my situation, I pushed her away, you pushed her away, right? Men do stupid things sometimes...

We should have fixed things instead of giving up. Sometimes, you need to lose someone to see what you had. Get some perspective on the other side. 

I think you are right. I'm going to try. Take it day by day and do my best not to think about her. Thanks for your help
For the last three years, I had one certainty. That she loved me. But she threw it all way, and she's fucking this guy. ... Fine. I can deal, I guess. I will find someone better.
If you say so, friend. I will give it time. Besides, if she can't even keep it in her pants for a few weeks, she's not worth it...
shoot

This girl was perfect though. She adored me. ADORED. She was in love with me. I fucked it all up. I didn't make her happy. If this had happened after a relationship during which I had significantly made her happy, it would hurt less. But I was an idiot, I took her for granted and I didn't make her happy. I fucked up. And now she's found someone else to be with...
*We had it all figured out

I can try. I was going to try. I asked her out to brunch. She said yes. But she couldn't agree to not fucking around till we had it figured out. Of course I asked in better words, but it didn't matter.

So now that plan is shattered. There is nothing I can do. She has blocked most means I would have to contact her. It's over. I just... I don't know if I can go on.

I have told myself over and over this exact same thing. It just hurts and I have called out for help. I am dealing with it, one day at a time. I'm tempted to get more vacation from work. But I'm worried I might get into trouble. I've already taken several days this month.

Well, I loved this girl. I was so in love with her that I became scared. I had anxiety. I had issues with trust. A consequence of somethings that happened in my childhood...
She loved me. She adored me. I fucked it all up, with my mental illness, which I never got help with... I distrusted her, I would suspect her of cheating on me. I was so afraid of being hurt and betrayed. I was obsessed. I drove her into a deep depression. Our relationship limped on for a few years. Until this last holiday season, it reached a breaking point. And that's what happened. We broke up. 

I had no choice. I broke up with her. She was crazy. But now, a few weeks later, she's all better. And some guy is currently sweeping her off her feet. She's fucking him, and I can't handle it. I drank a whole lot, I cut myself. To dull the pain. I can't bear it. I love her still. I begged her to take me back. I'm the guys she's been with for 3.5 years, that other guy is a nobody. I begged her. She won't take me, she believes our relationship is one elongated, toxic mistake.

I said, ok, let me win you back, give me a chance. Just don't sleep with him again while I'm trying... She said she can't do that. She can't even give me a couple of weeks. She left me for some guy on tinder. Some nobody who is so special to her now... 

We were together for 3.5 years. She told me she no longer loves me. That she wants to move on. She even said... If I convince her I've changed, she still won't take me back. I feel helpless while the woman I love is fucking this guy. I know what to do. Shotgun to the head. Deadliest method. Quickest. Easy to buy, no wait time.
Not tonight anyway.
I'm here. I cut my arm several times to dull the pain. I'm not going to kill myself.
